g.text: so future... you're from the future right?
Without getting over my head on Eternalism, yeah, I'm from the future.
tell me about all the aliens
Zaznog The Imbiber could drink you under the table.
you know, aliens, ufos, friggin probings!
whoa! really? what does he drink?
I hate to let you down...
There's the Sentients but I'm pretty sure that's not what you mean.
Piston oil, mostly. He loves piston oil.
the sentients came from earth originally though
not even like a message from a far off solar system?
i'm talking like in planet spacers
wait? are you messing with me?
funny looking aliens that fly around the galaxy at light speed making friends and fight bad guys
so many years in the future, there has to be something
or i don't know, that's why i'm asking
If there was, nobody ever told me.
If the Orokin discovered aliens, they kept it to themselves.
there must be aliens, tell me about them, i have to know
